apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
New
- Away from home, a new opening: the tunnel hangs above the logo, the line running up into it. Once connected the fish bites, the logo is reeled up into the tunnel, the tunnel comes down below it, and the logo rises out of its top into place.

Changed
- The next song is ready before it plays: its cover, colours, waveform and lyrics are fetched while the song before plays, so the pill and Now Playing change all at once. Covers in lists fade in as they arrive.
- Now Playing: when there's no room for the device's name beside the whole sound quality, the device shows as its icon (its menu has the name).

Fixed
- The apps used a lot of power while playing: Now Playing's waveform was drawn 60 times a second (on a Mac, about a third of a core); now only when it changes. Fresh catch's cover moves for a while when it comes on screen, then rests.
- "On its way" counted songs as albums ("2638 more albums to ask for"); it now says how many songs and how many albums.
- Phones: long playlists showed two scroll bars.

To update: the server (pull the new image) and the apps (the new opening away from home).
